claims.statement_id: Yemọja sering digambarkan sebagai putri duyung (mermaid) oleh sejumlah pemuja, dan di beberapa komunitas diaspora dikaitkan dengan air, misteri feminin, dan bulan.
claims.quote: Yemọja is often depicted as a mermaid by a number of devotees, and is associated with water, feminine mysteries, and the moon in some diaspora communities.

claims.statement: She is said to be able to cure infertility in women, and cowrie shells represent her wealth.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikatakan mampu menyembuhkan kemandulan pada perempuan, dan cangkang kauri (cowrie) melambangkan kekayaannya.
claims.quote: She is said to be able to cure infertility in women, and cowrie shells represent her wealth.

claims.statement: Her name is a contraction of the Yoruba words Iye (ìyá, mother), ọmọ (child) and ẹja (fish).
claims.statement_id: Namanya adalah singkatan kata-kata Yoruba Iye (ìyá, ibu), ọmọ (anak), dan ẹja (ikan).
claims.quote: Her name is a contraction of the Yoruba words Iye, a dialect variant of "ìyá" meaning "mother"; ọmọ, meaning "child"; and ẹja, meaning "fish"

claims.statement: In West Africa Yemọja is worshipped as a high-ranking river deity, but in Brazil and Cuba mainly as a sea or ocean deity.
claims.statement_id: Di Afrika Barat (West Africa) Yemọja dipuja sebagai dewi sungai berkedudukan tinggi, tetapi di Brasil (Brazil) dan Kuba (Cuba) ia terutama dipuja sebagai dewi laut.
claims.quote: In West Africa, Yemọja is worshipped as a high-ranking river deity, but in Brazil and Cuba she is worshipped mainly as a sea/ocean deity.

claims.statement: In Yorubaland it is Olókun who fills the role of sea deity, while Yemọja leads the other river deities.
claims.statement_id: Di Yorubaland, Olókun yang berperan sebagai dewa laut, sedangkan Yemọja adalah pemimpin para dewi sungai lainnya.
claims.quote: It is Olókun that fills the role of sea deity in Yorubaland, while Yemọja is a leader of the other river deities.

claims.statement: In Candomblé and Umbanda she is the Queen of the Ocean, patron of fishermen and shipwreck survivors, the feminine principle of creation and the spirit of moonlight.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Candomblé dan Umbanda ia adalah Ratu Samudra (Queen of the Ocean), pelindung nelayan dan penyintas kapal karam, prinsip feminin penciptaan, serta roh cahaya bulan.
claims.quote: She is the Queen of the Ocean, the patron spirit of the fishermen and the survivors of shipwrecks, the feminine principle of creation, and the spirit of moonlight.

claims.statement: In Candomblé and Umbanda, Yemanjá is one of the seven Orixás.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Candomblé dan Umbanda, Yemanjá adalah salah satu dari tujuh Orixá.
claims.quote: In Candomblé and Umbanda, Yemanjá is one of the seven Orixás.

claims.statement: Every February 2, thousands of people line up at dawn to leave offerings at her shrine in Rio Vermelho.
claims.statement_id: Setiap 2 Februari (February 2), ribuan orang antre sejak fajar untuk meninggalkan persembahan di tempat sucinya di Rio Vermelho.
claims.quote: Every February 2, thousands of people line up at dawn to leave their offerings at her shrine in Rio Vermelho.

claims.statement: In Santería or regla de ocha, Yemayá is the mother of all living things and the owner of the oceans and seas.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Santería atau regla de ocha, Yemayá adalah ibu segala makhluk hidup sekaligus pemilik samudra dan lautan.
claims.quote: In Santería or regla de ocha, Yemayá is the mother of all living things as well as the owner of the oceans and seas.

claims.statement: She is often shown as a water woman (Wasserfrau); in Brazil (Brasilien) she represents the salt water of the sea, while in Nigeria she is a river goddess in Ogun State.
claims.statement_id: Ia sering digambarkan sebagai perempuan air (Wasserfrau); di Brasil (Brasilien) ia mewakili air asin laut, sedangkan di Nigeria ia adalah dewi sungai di negara bagian Ogun.
claims.quote: Sie wird daher häufig als Wasserfrau dargestellt und repräsentiert z. B. in Brasilien das Salzwasser des Meeres, in Nigeria ist sie eine Flussgöttin im Bundesstaat Ogun.

claims.statement: In legend Yemayá is married (verheiratet) to Oxalá; because she talked so much he went mad, and Yemayá had to heal him, thereby becoming guardian of heads (Hüterin der Köpfe).
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Yemayá menikah (verheiratet) dengan Oxalá; karena ia terlalu banyak bicara, suaminya menjadi gila, lalu Yemayá harus menyembuhkannya dan dengan itu menjadi penjaga kepala (Hüterin der Köpfe).
claims.quote: Yemayá ist verheiratet mit Oxalá. Da sie so viel mit ihrem Mann redete, wurde er verrückt. ... Yemayá musste ihn heilen und wurde so zur Hüterin der Köpfe.

claims.statement: Her attributes are fish (Fische) and a hand mirror called Abebê; her weekday is Saturday (Samstag).
claims.statement_id: Atributnya adalah ikan (Fische) dan cermin tangan bernama Abebê; hari sucinya adalah Sabtu (Samstag).
claims.quote: Ihre Attribute sind Fische und ein Handspiegel namens Abebê. Ihr Wochentag ist der Samstag.

claims.statement: Yemayá is regarded as one of the most important orishas (wichtigsten Orishas) in Cuba.
claims.statement_id: Yemayá dianggap salah satu orisha terpenting (wichtigsten Orishas) di Kuba.
claims.quote: Yemayá gilt als eine der wichtigsten Orishas auf Kuba.

claims.statement: The third article says many stories tell how she became mother of all spirits (mère de tous les esprits), and states she was married (mariée) to Aganju.
claims.statement_id: Artikel ketiga menyebut banyak kisah tentang bagaimana ia menjadi ibu semua roh (mère de tous les esprits), dan menyatakan ia menikah (mariée) dengan Aganju.
claims.quote: Il existe de nombreuses histoires contant la façon dont elle est devenue la mère de tous les esprits. Elle était mariée à Aganju

claims.statement: Other stories (D'autres histoires) say Yemaya has always existed and all life, including all the orishas, was born from her.
claims.statement_id: Kisah lain (D'autres histoires) menyebut Yemaya selalu ada dan semua kehidupan lahir darinya, termasuk semua orisha.
claims.quote: D'autres histoires racontent que Yemaya a toujours existé et que toute vie est née d'elle, y compris tous les orishas.

issues.message: Tidak muncul di kutipan mana pun: Maggori. Tambahkan klaim yang kutipannya memuat hal ini, atau hapus dari teks.

claims.statement: The dingonek is a creature said to have been seen near Lake Victoria in 1907 by hunter John Alfred Jordan and his party, as recounted by Edgar Beecher Bronson in his 1910 memoir In Closed Territory.
claims.statement_id: Dingonek adalah makhluk yang konon terlihat dekat Danau Victoria (Lake Victoria) pada 1907 oleh pemburu John Alfred Jordan dan rombongannya, sebagaimana dikisahkan Edgar Beecher Bronson dalam memoar tahun 1910, In Closed Territory.
claims.quote: The dingonek is a creature said to have been seen near Lake Victoria in 1907 by big game hunter John Alfred Jordan and members of his hunting party, as recounted by fellow big-game hunter Edgar Beecher Bronson in his 1910 memoir In Closed Territory.

claims.statement: This account was followed by a 1913 article by Charles William Hobley in the East Africa Natural History Society, claiming further accounts of similarly described creatures.
claims.statement_id: Kisah itu disusul artikel Charles William Hobley tahun 1913 di East Africa Natural History Society, yang mengaku menemukan laporan lain tentang makhluk serupa.
claims.quote: This account was followed by an article published in 1913 in the East Africa Natural History Society by Charles William Hobley, in which he claims to have encountered further accounts of similarly described creatures.

claims.statement: In 1918 an article in MacLean's declared the beast a newly discovered animal species.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1918, sebuah artikel di MacLean's menyatakan makhluk itu spesies hewan (animal species) yang baru ditemukan.
claims.quote: In 1918, an article published by MacLean's declared that the beast was a newly discovered animal species.

claims.statement: One member of the party, Mataia, claims to have seen it twice, yet Bronson expressed skepticism.
claims.statement_id: Seorang anggota rombongan, Mataia, mengaku melihatnya dua kali, tetapi Bronson meragukannya (skepticism).
claims.quote: One member of the party, Mataia, claims to have seen it twice, yet Bronson expressed skepticism.

claims.statement: The witness quoted by Hobley describes it as spotted like a leopard, covered with scales and with a head like an otter; he did not see the long fangs described by Jordan.
claims.statement_id: Saksi yang dikutip Hobley menggambarkannya bertotol seperti macan tutul (leopard), bersisik, berkepala seperti berang-berang (otter), dan tidak melihat taring panjang seperti yang diceritakan Jordan.
claims.quote: He describes it as spotted like a leopard, covered with scales, and having a head like an otter; he did not see the long fangs described by Mr. Jordan.

claims.statement: The beast came floating down the river on a big log, and the witness estimated its length at about sixteen feet.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk itu hanyut di sungai di atas batang kayu besar (big log), dan saksi memperkirakan panjangnya sekitar enam belas kaki (sixteen feet).
claims.quote: The beast came floating down the river on a big log, and he estimated its length at about sixteen feet

claims.statement: According to Jordan it lives in Lake Victoria Nyanza and its numerous tributaries, with no record of it seen anywhere else in the world.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Jordan, makhluk itu hidup di Danau Victoria Nyanza dan banyak anak sungainya (tributaries), dan tidak pernah tercatat terlihat di tempat lain.
claims.quote: It lives in Lake Victoria Nyanza and its numerous tributaries, and there is no record of the monster having been seen in any other part of the world.

claims.statement: Jordan says the lake creature was christened Dingonek by the Lumbwa, and reckons it would fetch five or ten thousand quid at least.
claims.statement_id: Jordan menyebut makhluk dari danau itu dinamai Dingonek oleh orang Lumbwa, dan memperkirakan nilainya lima sampai sepuluh ribu pound (five or ten thousand quid).
claims.quote: lake the Lumbwa have christened Dingonek. And it's real prize money that beauty would fetch, five or ten thousand quid at least

claims.statement: The Lumbwa described it as some sort of cross between a sea serpent, a leopard and a whale.
claims.statement_id: Orang Lumbwa melukiskannya sebagai semacam campuran ular laut (sea serpent), macan tutul (leopard), dan paus (whale).
claims.quote: some sort of cross between a sea serpent, a leopard, and a whale

claims.statement: Jordan describes it as fourteen or fifteen feet long, with a head as big as a lioness's but marked like a leopard, two long white fangs from the upper jaw, a back as broad as a hippo, scaled like an armadillo, and a broad fin tail.
claims.statement_id: Jordan menggambarkannya sepanjang empat belas atau lima belas kaki (fourteen or fifteen feet), berkepala sebesar singa betina bercorak macan tutul, bertaring putih panjang dari rahang atas, berpunggung selebar kuda nil (hippo), bersisik seperti armadillo, dan berekor sirip lebar.
claims.quote: fourteen or fifteen feet long, head big as that of a lioness but shaped and marked like a leopard, two long white fangs sticking down straight out of his upper jaw, back broad as a hippo, scaled like an armadillo, but colored and marked like a leopard, and a broad fin tail

claims.statement: Jordan says its fangs looked long enough to go clean through a man.
claims.statement_id: Jordan berkata taringnya tampak cukup panjang untuk menembus tubuh manusia (go clean through a man).
claims.quote: Blast that blighter's fangs, but they looked long enough to go clean through a man.

claims.statement: Jordan shot it with a .303 from less than ten yards, but though they watched waters and shores over several miles for two days, they saw neither it nor its tracks.
claims.statement_id: Jordan menembaknya dengan peluru .303 dari jarak kurang dari sepuluh yard (ten yards), tetapi meski mencari selama dua hari sepanjang beberapa mil, mereka tak melihatnya lagi atau jejaknya.
claims.quote: a .303, where placed, should have killed anything, for he was less than ten yards from me when I shot, but though we watched waters and shores over a range of several miles for two days, no sight did we get of him or his tracks.

claims.statement: According to information in the memoir, a great water serpent or reptile was seen near the north shore of the lake and worshipped by the natives, who took its coming as a harbinger of heavy crops and increasing herds.
claims.statement_id: Menurut keterangan dalam memoar itu, seekor ular atau reptil air besar (water serpent or reptile) kadang terlihat di pantai utara danau dan disembah penduduk, yang menganggap kedatangannya pertanda panen melimpah dan ternak bertambah.
claims.quote: a great water serpent or reptile was seen on or near the north shore of the lake, which was worshipped by the natives, who believed its coming a harbinger of heavy crops and large increase of their flocks and herds.

claims.statement: People of the north shore of the lake sacrificed burnt offerings of cattle and sheep to a huge, terrible lake reptile they called Luquata.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk pantai utara danau mempersembahkan korban bakaran sapi dan domba (cattle and sheep) kepada reptil danau raksasa berpenampilan mengerikan yang mereka sebut Luquata.
claims.quote: sacrificed burnt offerings of cattle and sheep to a lake reptile of great size and terrible appearance they called Luquata, which occasionally appeared along or near the shore

claims.statement: The lightning bird, also impundulu, thekwane, izulu or inyoni yezulu, is a creature in the folklore of the Zulu people.
claims.statement_id: Burung petir (lightning bird), juga disebut impundulu, thekwane, izulu, atau inyoni yezulu, adalah makhluk dalam cerita rakyat orang Zulu.
claims.quote: The lightning bird or impundulu or thekwane (or izulu, inyoni yezulu) is a creature in the folklore of the Zulu people.

claims.statement: The impundulu takes the form of a black and white bird the size of a person, said to summon thunder and lightning with its wings and talons.
claims.statement_id: Impundulu berwujud burung hitam putih seukuran manusia (the size of a person) yang dikatakan memanggil guruh dan petir dengan sayap dan cakarnya.
claims.quote: takes the form of a black and white bird, the size of a person, which is said to summon thunder and lightning with its wings and talons.

claims.statement: It is a vampiric creature associated with witchcraft, often the servant or familiar of a witch or witch doctor, which attacks the witch's enemies.
claims.statement_id: Ia makhluk mirip vampir (vampiric) yang dikaitkan dengan ilmu sihir, sering menjadi pelayan atau hewan peliharaan gaib (familiar) penyihir, dan menyerang musuh penyihir itu.
claims.quote: It is a vampiric creature associated with witchcraft, often the servant or familiar of a witch or witch doctor, which attacks the witch's enemies.

claims.statement: It is said to have an insatiable appetite for blood, and sometimes takes the form of a beautiful young man who seduces women.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikatakan selalu haus darah (blood), dan kadang menjelma pemuda tampan (beautiful young man) yang merayu perempuan.
claims.quote: It is said to have an insatiable appetite for blood. Sometimes it takes the form of a beautiful young man who seduces women.

claims.statement: Among certain tribes the hammerkop is believed to be the lightning bird.
claims.statement_id: Di sebagian suku, burung hammerkop dipercaya sebagai burung petir (lightning bird).
claims.quote: Among certain African tribes the hammerkop is believed to be the lightning bird.

claims.statement: The lightning bird is said to be immortal, because it outlives its masters.
claims.statement_id: Burung petir dikatakan abadi (immortal) karena hidup lebih lama daripada tuan-tuannya.
claims.quote: it is said that the lightning bird is immortal, because it outlives its masters.

claims.statement: Legend recounts that the bird is passed down in a witch's family from mother to daughter, doing the bidding of its owner.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, burung itu diwariskan dalam keluarga penyihir dari ibu ke anak perempuan (mother to daughter) dan menjalankan perintah pemiliknya.
claims.quote: Legend recounts that the bird is passed down in a witch's family from mother to daughter, doing the bidding of its owner

claims.statement: The lightning bird is impervious to gunshots or stabbing and cannot be poisoned or drowned, but it is said it can be destroyed by fire.
claims.statement_id: Burung petir kebal terhadap tembakan dan tikaman, tidak dapat diracun atau ditenggelamkan, tetapi dikatakan dapat dimusnahkan dengan api (fire).
claims.quote: The lightning bird is impervious to gunshots or stabbing, it cannot be poisoned or drowned, but it is said that the creature can be destroyed by fire.

claims.statement: The bird is also believed to lay a large egg underground where the lightning strikes.
claims.statement_id: Burung itu juga dipercaya bertelur besar (large egg) di bawah tanah di tempat sambaran petir.
claims.quote: The bird is furthermore believed to lay a large egg underground at the location of the lightning strike.

claims.statement: It is considered an evil creature because it does the bidding of witches.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap makhluk jahat (evil creature) karena menjalankan perintah para penyihir (witches).
claims.quote: It is considered an evil creature because it does the bidding of witches.

claims.statement: The impundulu is a mythological creature (makhluk mitologi) in the folklore of peoples of southern Africa (Afrika bagian selatan), including the Pondo, Zulu and Xhosa.
claims.statement_id: Impundulu adalah makhluk mitologi dalam cerita rakyat suku-suku di Afrika bagian selatan, termasuk Pondo, Zulu, dan Xhosa.
claims.quote: makhluk mitologi dalam cerita rakyat suku-suku di Afrika bagian selatan, meliputi suku Pondo, Zulu dan Xhosa.

claims.statement: In Xhosa and Zulu mythology, an evil spirit which most often appears in the form of a bird; lightning bird.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Xhosa dan Zulu, impundulu adalah roh jahat (evil spirit) yang paling sering tampil sebagai burung; burung petir.
claims.quote: In Xhosa and Zulu mythology: an evil spirit which most often appears in the form of a bird; lightning bird.

claims.statement: People so attacked cough up blood and frequently die, so pulmonary tuberculosis is considered the work of the Impundulu.
claims.statement_id: Orang yang diserangnya batuk darah (cough up blood) dan sering meninggal, sehingga tuberkulosis paru (pulmonary tuberculosis) dianggap ulah Impundulu.
claims.quote: People so attacked cough up blood and frequently die. In consequence, pulmonary tuberculosis is considered as the work of the Impundulu.

claims.statement: The flapping of its huge wings produces thunder, and lightning is caused by hot fat dripping from its breast to earth.
claims.statement_id: Kepakan sayapnya yang besar menimbulkan guruh (thunder), dan petir berasal dari lemak panas (hot fat) yang menetes dari dadanya ke bumi.
claims.quote: the flapping of its huge wings produces thunder, and lightning is caused by the hot fat which drips from its breast, falling to earth.

claims.statement: Impundulu, a lightning bird, appeared in the form of an extremely handsome man.
claims.statement_id: Impundulu dikenal sebagai burung petir yang menampakkan diri sebagai pria yang sangat tampan (extremely handsome man).
claims.quote: Impundulu, a lightning bird, who appeared in the form of an extremely handsome man.

claims.statement: So named because, according to Zulu lore, the bird is left behind on the ground when lightning strikes.
claims.statement_id: Burung ini dinamai demikian karena menurut kepercayaan Zulu ia tertinggal di tanah (left behind on the ground) saat petir menyambar.
claims.quote: So named because, according to Zulu lore, the bird is left behind on the ground when lightning strikes.

claims.statement: The Southern Sotho imagine the lightning bird as a hamerkop, the Venda as an eagle, and the peoples of the north-western Transvaal as a flamingo.
claims.statement_id: Wujud burung petir berbeda-beda: orang Sotho Selatan membayangkannya sebagai hamerkop, orang Venda sebagai elang (eagle), dan bangsa-bangsa di barat laut Transvaal sebagai flamingo.
claims.quote: the Southern Sotho imagine the lightning bird as a hamerkop, the Venda imagine it as an eagle, and the peoples of the north-western Transvaal imagine it as a flamingo

claims.statement: The Baronga identify the lightning-bird with a hawk called chimungu, believed to bury itself in the ground where it strikes.
claims.statement_id: Orang Baronga menyamakan burung petir dengan sejenis elang (hawk) bernama chimungu yang dipercaya membenamkan diri ke tanah di tempat ia menyambar.
claims.quote: The Baronga identify the lightning-bird with a hawk called chimungu, which is believed to bury itself in the ground where it strikes.

claims.statement: When it darts down as lightning, people only see the flash.
claims.statement_id: Saat burung itu menukik turun sebagai petir, orang hanya melihat kilatannya (flash).
claims.quote: When it darts down as lightning people only see the flash.

issues.message: Kutipan tidak persis sama dengan teks di https://www.gutenberg.org/files/5891/5891-h/5891-h.htm (hanya 84% cocok). Buka lagi halamannya dan salin ulang kutipannya kata per kata.

claims.statement: An Obambou, also Obambo or Obamba, is a supernatural being belonging to tribes of Central Africa.
claims.statement_id: Obambou, juga disebut Obambo atau Obamba, adalah makhluk gaib (supernatural being) milik suku-suku di Afrika Tengah (Central Africa).
claims.quote: An Obambou, also Obambo or Obamba, is a supernatural being belonging to tribes of Central Africa.

claims.statement: It is depicted as evil, with the power to do evil or good if it chooses, able to possess and cause sickness, or to want a home built for it.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan jahat (evil), mampu berbuat jahat maupun baik bila mau, dapat merasuki (possess) dan menyebabkan sakit, atau meminta dibuatkan rumah.
claims.quote: It is depicted as evil, possessing the power to do evil and to do good if it chooses, having the ability to possess and cause sickness, or to want a home built for them.

claims.statement: In some tribes an Obambou is referred to as a devil, or as the spirit of someone who was not buried correctly.
claims.statement_id: Di sebagian suku, Obambou disebut iblis (devil) atau arwah (spirit) orang yang tidak dikuburkan dengan benar.
claims.quote: In some African tribes, an Obambou is referred to as a devil, or as the spirit of someone who was not buried correctly.

claims.statement: The Commi tribe believed that when someone is severely ill an Obambou is a likely culprit, which can be determined by a doctor.
claims.statement_id: Suku Commi percaya bahwa bila seseorang sakit parah, Obambou kemungkinan penyebabnya, dan hal itu dapat ditentukan oleh seorang dukun (doctor).
claims.quote: The Commi tribe believed that when someone is severely ill, an Obambou is a likely culprit which can be determined by a doctor

claims.statement: The M'pongwe tribe believed a person can be born with the spirit known as an Obambou and be born insane.
claims.statement_id: Suku M'pongwe percaya seseorang dapat lahir bersama roh (spirit) Obambou dan lahir dalam keadaan gila (insane).
claims.quote: The M'pongwe tribe believed that a person can be born with the spirit known as an Obambou and be born insane.

claims.statement: In some tribes Obambou is married to a female spirit.
claims.statement_id: Di sebagian suku, Obambou dikatakan menikah (married) dengan roh perempuan (female spirit).
claims.quote: In some tribes, Obambou is married to a female spirit.

claims.statement: One of the Commi people's theories of disease is that Obambou (the devil) has got into the sick man, and while the devil remains in the body there is no hope of curing him.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu teori penyakit orang Commi adalah bahwa Obambou (iblis/devil) telah masuk ke tubuh orang sakit, dan selama ia tinggal di tubuh itu tidak ada harapan sembuh.
claims.quote: One of the Commi people's theories of disease is, that Obambou (the devil) has got into the sick man, and as long as the devil remains in the body there is no hope of curing the man.

claims.statement: This devil can only be driven out by noise: a great crowd surrounds the sick man, beats drums and kettles close to his head and fires guns close to his ears.
claims.statement_id: Iblis ini hanya dapat diusir dengan bunyi (noise): kerumunan besar mengelilingi orang sakit, memukul genderang dan ketel (drums and kettles) dekat kepalanya, dan menembakkan senapan (guns) dekat telinganya.
claims.quote: Now this devil is only to be driven out by noise, and accordingly a great crowd surround the sick man and beat drums and kettles close to his head, fire off guns close to his ears

claims.statement: Abambou is the devil of the Commi people; a wicked and mischievous fellow who often lives near graves and burial-grounds and is most comfortably lodged among the skeletons of the dead.
claims.statement_id: Abambou adalah iblis (devil) orang Commi; ia jahat dan usil, sering tinggal dekat kuburan (graves and burial-grounds), dan paling nyaman berdiam di antara kerangka orang mati.
claims.quote: Abambou is the devil of the Commi people. He is a wicked and mischievous fellow, who often lives near graves and burial-grounds, and is most comfortably lodged among the skeletons of the dead.

claims.statement: He takes occasional walks through the country and, if angry at anyone, has the power to cause sickness and death.
claims.statement_id: Ia sesekali berjalan-jalan melintasi negeri, dan bila marah kepada seseorang ia berkuasa menimbulkan sakit dan kematian (sickness and death).
claims.quote: He takes occasional walks through the country, and, if he gets angry at anyone, he has the power to cause sickness and death.

claims.statement: The Commi people cook food for him, deposit it in lonely places in the woods, and there address him flatteringly and ask him to be good to them.
claims.statement_id: Orang Commi memasak makanan (food) untuknya, menaruhnya di tempat sepi di hutan (woods), lalu menyapanya dengan sanjungan dan memintanya berbaik hati kepada mereka.
claims.quote: The Commi people cook food for him, which is deposited in lonely places in the woods, and there they address him in a flattering manner, and ask him to be good to them

claims.statement: In Aniambia there are two fetich-houses protected by two powerful spirits, Abambou and Mbiuri; the former is an evil spirit, a kind of devil, the latter beneficent.
claims.statement_id: Di Aniambia ada dua rumah jimat (fetich-houses) yang dilindungi dua roh berkuasa, Abambou dan Mbiuri; yang pertama roh jahat semacam iblis, yang kedua bersifat baik (beneficent).
claims.quote: There are two very curious fetich-houses in Aniambia, which enjoy the protection of two spirits of great power—Abambou and Mbiuri. The former is an evil spirit, a kind of devil; the latter, as far as I have been able to ascertain, is beneficent.

claims.statement: In M'pongwe belief, if someone is born mad or sickly, one of the evil spirits such as an Olâgâ or an Obambo, the soul of a man that has not been buried properly, has been born with him.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan M'pongwe, bila seseorang lahir gila atau sakit-sakitan, salah satu roh jahat seperti Olâgâ atau Obambo, yaitu jiwa orang yang tidak dikuburkan dengan layak (not been buried properly), telah lahir bersamanya.
claims.quote: if he is born mad, or sickly, one of the evil spirits such as an Olâgâ or an Obambo, the soul of a man that has not been buried properly, has been born with him.

claims.statement: When the dead are weary of staying in the bush, they come for one of their people whom they most affect.
claims.statement_id: Bila orang mati sudah lelah tinggal di semak belukar (bush), mereka mendatangi salah seorang kerabat yang paling mereka sayangi.
claims.quote: When the dead are weary of staying in the bush, they come for one of their people whom they most affect.

claims.statement: The spirit says it is tired of dwelling in the bush and asks for a little house to be built in the town as close as possible to the visited person's own.
claims.statement_id: Arwah itu berkata bahwa ia lelah tinggal di semak (bush) dan meminta dibangunkan rumah kecil (little house) di kampung sedekat mungkin dengan rumah orang yang didatanginya.
claims.quote: I am tired of dwelling in the bush; please to build for me in the town a little house as close as possible to your own.

claims.statement: Next day the people go to the grave of the Obambo, or ghost, make a rude idol, and carry the bamboo bier of the body and some dust of the ground into a little hut near the house of the visited, draping a white cloth over the door.
claims.statement_id: Keesokan harinya orang pergi ke kubur Obambo (ghost), membuat berhala (idol) sederhana, lalu membawa usungan bambu (bamboo bier) jenazah dan sedikit debu kubur ke pondok kecil dekat rumah orang yang didatangi, dan pintunya ditutup kain putih (white cloth).
claims.quote: Then, next day, the people repair to the grave of the Obambo, or ghost, and make a rude idol; after which the bamboo bier on which the body is conveyed to the grave, and some of the dust of the ground, are carried into a little hut erected near the house of the visited, and a white cloth is draped over the door.

claims.statement: People possessed by an adze are viewed as witches (Ewe: abasom).

claims.quote: People, male or female, possessed by an adze are viewed as witches (Ewe: abasom ).

claims.statement: In firefly form, the adze enters homes at night through keyholes to suck blood from sleeping victims.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud kunang-kunang, Adze masuk melalui lubang kunci dan celah pintu malam hari untuk menghisap darah saat tidur.
claims.quote: In firefly form, the adze would travel through keyholes, cracks in walls, or under closed doors at night. Once in the home, it would suck blood from people as they slept, making them fall sick and die. Tales of the creature and its effects were probably an attempt to describe the potentially deadly effects of mosquitoes and malaria. There is no defense against an adze.

claims.statement: The adze's influence would negatively affect the people who lived around their host.
claims.statement_id: Pengaruh Adze membawa dampak buruk bagi orang-orang di sekitar inangnya.
